name: Whitney Reddick
comment: I use this app everyday for my daughters nap time and bedtime. This app has made a huge change in my life. My daughter can not sleep without it and it puts her to sleep within 5 minutes of playing it. As a first time mom this is the best thing that has ever happened to me.

name: Nonyelum Abana
comment: This app is a wonder! My baby is such an active boy and he falls asleep 😴 in less than 5 minutes when the songs are playing. Today, it took just a minute of play to fall asleep. Many times, the moment the music comes up, my baby starts making sounds that denote 'sleep time is here'. If there was anything more than 5 stars, I'll give it.

name: Janani A. Ganesh
comment: Good selection of songs and you can browse other things while it's playing

name: Rachel Fain
comment: The Music is awesome and doesn't only put my baby to sleep but also puts me to sleep too!

name: Patricia Diehl
comment: I'm an adult, listening to this beautiful music. Mozart transcends all generations and all ages. My inner child finds peace and relaxation listening to these lullabies. Live on Mozart. 🙏🙏🙏

name: Abbie Boscarino
comment: Love this! I suggest it to all of my friends! It helps my baby and toddler sleep so soundly, even my teenager downloaded it because she likes it.

name: Conroy Daniels
comment: Fantastic, my daughter is quite the genius after listening to Mozart while she sleeps.

name: Matthew Sampson
comment: I use this everyday for naps and bedtime. A life saver!!

name: Amanda Graves-Oliver
comment: My baby loves this. Calms her down even when she isn't tired. Has been a blessing while teething.

name: Lil Miss Nightmare
comment: Helps my anxiety and depression along with lowering my stress. Really helps the kiddos calm down too. Puts my hubby to sleep every time he hears it through the baby monitor. 5 out of 5 ☆!
